entities.summary: Kenneth Pereira is a field hockey midfielder from Canada. He was a member of the Canadian field hockey team at the Summer Olympics in 2000 and 2008. Pereira has also been on several Commonwealth Games and Pan American Games teams, winning two gold medals in the latter competition in 1999 and 2007. In the 1999 Pan American Games gold-medal match against Argentina, the only goal in Canada's win was posted by Pereira. Ken Pereira was a athletes & competitors from South Unionville (b. 1973-07-12, South Unionville). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
